messages:
anya: Quick sync — planning to land the search-relevance PR and a tiny model config change tomorrow. Target canary window 11:00-11:30 PT. Who's taking smoke and who needs a heads-up?

sahil: I can own the deploy lane. PR is green but I need one more CR on the config tweak (small YAML). ETA CR by EOD.

jen: I can run smoke after canary stabilizes. What are the specific checks you want me to run? perf, top-n precision, and error budget check? :thinking_face:

anya: Yep — perf (p50/p95), sample outputs for top-20 queries, and sanity on embeddings endpoint (no regressions). Also validate token-cost delta.

dave: I'm on-call that window. If smoke fails, what's rollback plan?

sahil: Rollback = revert canary tag -> roll forward stable. I'll keep the deploy playbook open. If latency > 2x baseline or >1% error uplink, we revert.

anya: tagging @jen and @dave in the canary notes. I'll post the deploy commands in the thread before kicking off.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window for team-search: 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z - 2026-04-02T18:30:00Z (canary). Reminder: attach smoke checklist and rollout notes.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passing on main + integration tests (2:14m). Model validation suite: passed.

jen: ok I'll prepare the smoke checklist and a short runbook snippet. Pls include the curl snippets for verification.

anya: Draft curl checks (put in thread):
1) curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"search: apple"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
2) curl -sS https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"apple"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'  

sahil: I'll wait on jen's checklist then ship. If I don't ping by 17:30 PT assume I'm blocked and someone else take the lane.

dave: noted. I'll monitor infra metrics and be ready to flip the fallback. Add me to the incident channel for that window.

anya: thanks all — I'll post the final checklist and the PR link once CR is in. Short follow-up: does anyone want a staggered canary (2x 15m) instead of 30m single?

jen: 2x15m preferred for us, gives a chance to verify telemetry after initial traffic ingress.

sahil: ok will set canary = 15m, wait 5m metric review, then second 15m. I'll update the deploy descriptor.

anya: perfect. closing the loop: canary slices -> 10%, then 50%. We'll keep rollback thresholds strict. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
